basic_details.job_title: BECIL Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 23 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Candidates who have passed at least 12th, know computer packages and type more than 35 words per minute in English can apply online until 17 November 2026, 11:59 PM, for 23 Data Entry Operator posts with Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL), a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting. The posts are purely on contract basis for deployment in AIIMS CAPFIMS, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi, at a consolidated pay of Rs.26,208/- per month. Applications go through the portal becilregistration.in.

how_to_apply: The application must be submitted online through the BECIL application portal, along with all requisite documents as specified against the eligibility criteria of the post. The notice gives these steps:
Visit https://becilregistration.in to complete the online registration process.
Fill in the personal details under new registration and register.
Proceed to the other details and payment to complete the application submission process.
Pay the application processing fee for your category, as shown in the table below.
Save the application receipt after the online payment is successful.

The fee once paid is non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances. A candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and pay the fee separately for each post. BECIL does not demand or accept any payment at any stage of the recruitment process other than the prescribed Application Processing Fee, wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Data Entry Operator at a Glance

rows.details: AIIMS CAPFIMS, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About BECIL
content_sections.text: Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited is a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting and a Mini Ratna Company. Its Head Office is at 14-B, Ring Road, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002 (Phone: 011-23378823). Its Corporate Office is at BECIL Bhawan, C-56/A-17, Sector-62, Noida-201307 (Phone: 0120-4177850 / 4177860, Fax: 0120-4177879).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The essential qualification for the Data Entry Operator post has three parts: Minimum 12th passed from a recognized board/institution. Well conversant with computer packages namely Windows, i.e. Word, Excel course of DOEACC or equivalent from any Govt. / Recognized private institute, with good working knowledge of Computer and internet/E-mail. Typing speed of more than 35 words per minute (English) on computer. Preference: Preference may be given to candidates with higher qualifications, superior academic credentials, additional relevant experience or any other desirable criteria, as determined by the Client/Principal Employer. Preference may also be given to local candidates and/or candidates with relevant experience in the same or similar department, subject to the requirements of the Client/Principal Employer. Not eligible: Candidates previously engaged by BECIL and/or the Client are not eligible if their services were terminated, discontinued or not renewed on account of disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance or violation of contractual terms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Data Entry Operator
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted online through the BECIL application portal, along with all requisite documents as specified against the eligibility criteria of the post. The notice gives these steps: Visit https://becilregistration.in to complete the online registration process. Fill in the personal details under new registration and register. Proceed to the other details and payment to complete the application submission process. Pay the application processing fee for your category, as shown in the table below. Save the application receipt after the online payment is successful. The fee once paid is non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances. A candidate applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and pay the fee separately for each post. BECIL does not demand or accept any payment at any stage of the recruitment process other than the prescribed Application Processing Fee, wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: BECIL first scrutinises the applications, then forwards a shortlist to the Client/Principal Employer, who decides the further selection process. Scrutiny and shortlisting: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted on the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post. BECIL reserves the right to adopt suitable shortlisting criteria, including but not limited to higher qualifications, greater relevant experience or any other criteria deemed appropriate. No automatic call: Possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for any stage of selection. Further selection: The further process includes interview, assessment, skill test or any other evaluation method as may be decided by the Client. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told the date, time and venue/mode of the interview, assessment or skill test (if any) through registered email and/or telephone. Result: Candidates selected by the Client/Principal Employer are informed of their selection and subsequent formalities through email and/or telephone. BECIL is not obliged to publish interim results, stage-wise shortlists or marks. Only the final result, listing the selected candidates, is published on the official website of BECIL. Decisions of the Client/Principal Employer and BECIL on eligibility, shortlisting, selection and engagement are final and binding, and no correspondence on them is entertained.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications submitted after this date and time will not be considered and will be summarily rejected. No request to extend the last date will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BECIL Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BECIL Advertisement No. 566 lists 23 Data Entry Operator posts. The number is tentative and may increase or decrease depending on the requirements of the Client/Principal Employer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BECIL Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 17 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM. Applications submitted after that are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BECIL Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Minimum 12th passed from a recognized board/institution is required, along with the computer package course of DOEACC or equivalent, good working knowledge of computer and internet/e-mail, and an English typing speed of more than 35 words per minute on computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BECIL Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years, applicable as on the publishing date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a BECIL Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.26,208/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BECIL Advertisement No. 566?
faq.answer: The application processing fee is Rs.295/- for all other categories and NIL for SC/ST, PWD candidates. The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the BECIL Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: Register on https://becilregistration.in, fill in the personal and other details, and complete the payment to submit the application. Save the application receipt after the online payment is successful.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the BECIL Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: BECIL scrutinises and shortlists applications, then forwards the list to the Client/Principal Employer. The further process includes interview, assessment, skill test or any other evaluation method as may be decided by the Client.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BECIL Data Entry Operator job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is purely on contract basis, for deployment in AIIMS CAPFIMS, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Will BECIL pay TA/DA for the interview or for joining?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is admissible for attending any test, document verification, interview, personal interaction or skill test, or for joining duties upon selection.
